_comment: Markets this resolver watches, and the rule preimage the chain cannot give back.
The on-chain AdjudicatorEntry stores attestor, comparator, threshold and value scale,
plus rule_hash — a COMMITMENT to (url, parsePath), not the values. A hash cannot be
inverted, so the endpoint and field have to be supplied here. Everything else is read
from the chain and never taken from this file, and the (url, parsePath) pair below is
verified against the market's rule_hash before any attestation is requested.
Fields: market (base58 pubkey), url, parsePath, keyName are required.
parseType defaults to "string", method to "GET", header to {"accept":"application/json"}.
Set enabled:false to park a market without deleting it.
